payload.description:
As a dispatcher I want Claude session and weekly leftover with reset times so I can decide whether Claude spare capacity exists.

Wrap a curated CLI (cclimits or CodexBar), do not scrape claude.ai cookies.

Feature: Claude leftover
  Scenario: weekly window is present
    Given a working Claude leftover probe
    When Spotticus asks for Claude leftover
    Then it reports used percent and resets_at for the weekly window
    And it fails closed if the probe is unreadable
payload.title: Claude leftover is readable as session and weekly windows
